name: Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat
source:
Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat is an educational game, designed to be the ideal introductory course to the Japanese language! It's the third game in a smash-hit series, following Hiragana Battle and Katakana War - but you don't need to have played those!

This new game teaches you a separate part of Japanese: the Kanji writing system. Everything you need to start learning Japanese is contained within the game!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/759440/Learn_Japanese_To_Survive_Kanji_Combat/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat》是一款教育游戏，旨在成为理想的日语入门课程！本作是这一热门系列继《Hiragana Battle》和《Katakana War》之后的第三部作品，不过，你无需玩过前两作！

这次，你将学习日语书写体系中的另一个部分——汉字。开始学习日语所需的内容，游戏中都已准备齐全！

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/759440/Learn_Japanese_To_Survive_Kanji_Combat/]Steam[/url]]
